CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.position_data
(
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    "timestamp" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    latitude numeric(10, 7) NOT NULL,
    longitude numeric(10, 7) NOT NULL,
    altitude numeric(8, 2),
    speed_over_ground numeric(5, 2),
    course_over_ground numeric(5, 2),
    magnetic_variation double precision,
    fix_quality integer NOT NULL,
    satellites_used integer NOT NULL,
    hdop numeric(4, 2),
    source character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    is_synced boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    origin_node character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT p_k_position_data PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.position_data.latitude
    IS 'Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to +90)';

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.position_data.longitude
    IS 'Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to +180)';

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.position_data.altitude
    IS 'Altitude in meters above MSL';

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.position_data.speed_over_ground
    IS 'Speed in knots';

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.position_data.course_over_ground
    IS 'Course in degrees true';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stock_receipt_items
(
    id integer NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 2147483647 CACHE 1 ),
    receipt_id integer NOT NULL,
    store_location_id uuid,
    material_item_id uuid,
    item_code character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    item_name character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    description text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    unit character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    quantity_requested numeric(14, 3) NOT NULL,
    quantity_received numeric(14, 3) NOT NULL,
    unit_cost numeric(18, 2),
    currency character varying(3) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    note text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    CONSTRAINT p_k_stock_receipt_items PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stock_receipts
(
    id integer NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 2147483647 CACHE 1 ),
    receipt_code character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    supplier_code character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",

    received_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    receipt_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    created_by character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    notes text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    material_request_id integer,
    status character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    origin_node character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    attachments text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    vessel_name character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    voyage_id uuid,
    voyage_name character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    CONSTRAINT p_k_stock_receipts PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sync_queue
(
    id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ),
    table_name character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    record_key character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    action_type integer NOT NULL,
    payload text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    priority integer NOT NULL,
    retry_count integer NOT NULL,
    max_retries integer NOT NULL,
    next_retry_at timestamp with time zone,
    last_error character varying(500) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    synced_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT p_k_sync_queue PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

);

    new_values text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",

    duration_ms integer,

    origin_node character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    is_synced boolean NOT NULL,

);

    id uuid NOT NULL,
    voyage_number character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    departure_port character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    departure_time timestamp with time zone,
    arrival_port character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    arrival_time timestamp with time zone,
    cargo_type character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    cargo_weight numeric(12, 3),
    distance_traveled numeric(10, 2),
    fuel_consumed numeric(10, 3),
    average_speed numeric(5, 2),
    voyage_status character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    is_synced boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    origin_node character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    arrival_port_code character varying(5) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    call_sign character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    departure_port_code character varying(5) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    previous_port_code character varying(5) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    previous_port_name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    vessel_flag character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    vessel_i_m_o character varying(10) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    vessel_name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    approved_at timestamp with time zone,
    arrived_at timestamp with time zone,
    cancelled_at timestamp with time zone,
    charter_type character varying(40) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    commenced_at timestamp with time zone,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    planned_average_speed numeric(5, 2),
    planned_distance numeric(10, 2),
    planned_duration_hours numeric(10, 2),
    planned_fuel_consumption numeric(10, 3),
    ready_at timestamp with time zone,
    voyage_instructions text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    estimated_profit_margin double precision,
    total_estimated_cost double precision,
    total_estimated_revenue double precision,
    actual_profit_margin double precision,
    financial_closed_at timestamp with time zone,
    financial_closed_by character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    financial_status character varying(30) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN'::character varying,
    outstanding_balance double precision,
    total_actual_cost double precision,
    total_actual_revenue double precision,
    total_advanced double precision,
    total_disbursed double precision,
    CONSTRAINT p_k_voyage_records PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT p_k_voyage_revenue_estimates PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

    total_diesel_oil_consumed double precision NOT NULL,
    average_fuel_per_day double precision NOT NULL,
    fuel_efficiency double precision NOT NULL,
    fuel_oil_r_o_b double precision NOT NULL,
    diesel_oil_r_o_b double precision NOT NULL,

    total_maintenance_hours double precision NOT NULL,
    critical_issues integer NOT NULL,
    safety_incidents integer NOT NULL,
    port_calls integer NOT NULL,
    total_cargo_loaded double precision NOT NULL,
    total_cargo_discharged double precision NOT NULL,
    status character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    prepared_by character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    master_signature character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    signed_at timestamp with time zone,
    remarks text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",

ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.voyage_crew_change_plans
    ADD CONSTRAINT f_k_voyage_crew_change_plans__voyage_records_voyage_id FOREIGN KEY (voyage_id)
    REFERENCES public.voyage_records (id) MATCH SIMPLE
    ON UPDATE NO ACTION
    ON DELETE CASCADE;


ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.voyage_crew_change_plans
    ADD CONSTRAINT f_k_voyage_crew_change_plans_crew_members_crew_member_id FOREIGN KEY (crew_member_id)
    REFERENCES public.crew_members (id) MATCH SIMPLE
    ON UPDATE NO ACTION
    ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_voyage_crew_change_plan_crew
    ON public.voyage_crew_change_plans(crew_member_id);

    REFERENCES public.ranks (id) MATCH SIMPLE
    ON UPDATE NO ACTION
    ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IX_voyage_crew_change_plans_rank_id"
    ON public.voyage_crew_change_plans(rank_id);
